name: champions-ai
description: Pokémon Champions live battle tracker with persistent sessions and explainable action evaluation

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && node scripts/copy-static.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/server/core/*.test.js dist/server/server/*.test.js
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
